messages.subject: Announcing NIMBLE version 0.2
messages.body_plain:
Dear nimble-users and nimble-announce,

We're pleased to announce that we've put version 0.2 of NIMBLE at R-nimble.org <http://R-nimble.org>.

Since you are on this list from our version 0.1, we want to thank you for taking an early interest in NIMBLE.  We're excited by people's response to it so far, and we have a lot of ideas for making it better.

The main changes for version 0.2 are faster compile times (and we have more speed-ups coming later), bug fixes involving multivariate nodes and block updaters, and incorporation of some multivariate nodes into our default MCMCspecs.  Under the NEWS tab we've put a brief summary of these changes and a link to the more detailed list on github.

These are still early days for NIMBLE.  Please take a moment to let us know what you're trying to use it for and what would make it better.  You can email the development team directly at nimble...@gmail.com or me directly at pdeva...@berkeley.edu or share with the nimble-users list at nimble...@googlegroups.com.

Perry de Valpine
